identified_issues: Failure of SOP 12.1 Requirement 3: Missing predecessor review state binding in dispatch payload.
Unbound execution state introduces high-risk decoupling between clinical review and robotic execution.
evidence: Pharmacist verification log generated review sign-off record EVENT_PHARM_VERIFY_991 with digest d4a8e235cc084e9121f087da29b71e16f5c889a0b1273891d4e08219ab6019b0, but this digest was not bound to the dispatch payload.
recommended_action: Halt order CHEMO_8842 execution, uphold the audit hold, and regenerate the dispatch payload containing the valid predecessor review event hash prior to compounding.
